items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was there with Tom Alba, you know. Tom Alba still got that place.

ctx.x: I saw a little dick named White Bear. He hangs in a burglar's spread out of the hood. Him and this fellow Deku. That's where they hang out. Every night if I want to find him to look him up.
Well they, let's see, Deku was living with the two of them. I was there with Tom Alba, you know. Tom Alba still got that place. Oh, down Burgundy Street?
